title: Approvals, gates and deployment to a slot with rollback

videos.script: Most deployments go wrong in the first five minutes. {{five}} So the shop never deploys straight into production. The new version goes into a second copy of the app, called a slot. It warms up there, and somebody looks. {{slot}} Then a swap exchanges the two. The old version is still there, one swap away. {{swap}} Before any of that, the pipeline waits. A person approves, or a check asks whether production is healthy right now. {{gate}} One thing a swap cannot undo is a change to the data. This lesson ends there, because that is where rollback stops being a button. {{data}}
